module "MF_SampleTinted.dss"

product 0 MaterialFunction "SampleTinted" backend=Graph
  %0 = FunctionInput(InputName="Tex", InputType="Texture2D", IsOptional=false, SortPriority=0) : Texture2D @L3:C1 "Tex"
  %1 = FunctionInput(InputName="UV", InputType="Vector2", IsOptional=false, SortPriority=1) : float2 @L3:C1 "UV"
  %2 = FunctionInput(InputName="InTint", InputType="Vector3", IsOptional=false, SortPriority=2) : float3 @L3:C1 "InTint"
  %3 = TextureSample(%0, %1, _, _) : [RGBA:float4, R:float, G:float, B:float, A:float] @L6:C20 "Texel"
  %4 = Swizzle(%3, Mask="xyz") : float3 @L7:C13 "RGB"
  %5 = Multiply(%4, %2) : float3 @L7:C13 "RGB"
  %6 = Swizzle(%3, Mask="w") : float @L8:C13 "Alpha"
  %7 = FunctionOutput(%5, OutputName="RGB", SortPriority=0) @L3:C1 "RGB"
  %8 = FunctionOutput(%6, OutputName="Alpha", SortPriority=1) @L3:C1 "Alpha"
  inputs %0, %1, %2
  outputs %7, %8
